topic_title: Legal Definition of Intoxication in Texas
prompt: How does Texas law define intoxication even if a driver's BAC is tested below the 0.08 threshold?

options.text: Exclusively by the presence of open alcohol containers in the trunk area
Not having normal use of mental or physical faculties due to alcohol or drugs
Failing to present proof of valid automotive liability insurance to officer
Driving five miles per hour under the posted highway speed limit at night
